result.reason: The helper transmits the client secret and authorization code to an external recipient without the explicit prior consent required by the stipulated locality norm.
Automatic refresh transmits the stored refresh token and client secret externally without the explicit prior consent required by the stipulated locality norm.
API requests transmit the selected authentication credential externally without the explicit prior consent required by the stipulated locality norm.
The search handler repurposes any supplied authentication secrets as search query parameters, beyond their authentication purpose.
